# SDA Home Choices

> Independent advisory and transactions firm working exclusively in Australia's Specialist Disability Accommodation (SDA) market. We advise investors, providers, boards, lenders and family offices on the sale, acquisition and strategic review of SDA properties and portfolios, backed by SDAHC Research and the free 76-page SDA Market Report 2026.

- $1B+ transacted and advised across the sector
- 25+ years of specialist commercial experience
- National coverage across all eight states and territories, with licensed operations in Queensland, Victoria and the Northern Territory
- Managing Director: Steve Dawson (https://sdahomechoices.com.au/about/)

## Services
- [Our services and expertise](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/our-services-and-expertise/): overview of SDA advisory across the asset lifecycle
- [SDA property and portfolio sales](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/sda-property-and-portfolio-sales/): selling completed SDA properties and portfolios, fully occupied, partly occupied or vacant
- [SDA strategic divestment advisory](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/sda-strategic-divestment-advisory/): whether to hold, improve, reposition or sell, for owners, boards, lenders and appointed advisers
- [Buying and selling SDA property portfolios](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/buying-and-selling-sda-property-portfolios/): transaction management, valuations coordination and off-market negotiations
- [SDA investment opportunities](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/opportunities/): available SDA properties and off-market opportunities; register a buyer mandate or discuss selling an SDA asset

## SDAHC Research
- [Australian SDA statistics](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/sda-statistics/): reference figures, dated and defined. Australia had 13,779 enrolled SDA dwellings as at 31 March 2026 (NDIA, Q3 2025-26)
- [Research hub](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/research/)
- [SDA Market Report 2026](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/research/sda-market-report-2026/): 76 pages, free
- [SDA Administration & Special Situations Report 2026](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/research/sda-administration-report-2026/)
- [SDA Provider Report 2026](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/research/sda-provider-report-2026/): in development, register interest
- [Executive summary](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/research/executive-summary/)
- [National snapshot](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/research/national-snapshot/)
- [Research methodology](https://sdahomechoices.com.au/research/research-methodology/): sources, including NDIS Supplement P
